query: My potted mint plant on the windowsill finally sprouted those tiny new leaves I’ve been waiting for all week, it even survived the sudden heavy rain we had yesterday that knocked over my outdoor flower box full of marigolds. I also just finished making a batch of lemon honey tea with some of the older mint leaves I harvested last month, it turned out way less bitter than the last batch I tried making. Oh right, I also wanted to ask if I could pick up that extra pack of scented candles I ordered last week on my way to the grocery store tomorrow? Wait no, let me get to the actual thing I need help with: I’m looking to return some items from my delivered order #W9502127, the items I want to return are 2872451762 and 9534205511, and please process the refund to my paypal_2433177.
